collection_timeout.description: The collection timeout in seconds. Must be greater than or equal to tx.reput_block_duration and tx.dos_block_timeout. Default: 600 (10 minutes).

crs_setup_version.description: Numerical representation of the CRS version number (e.g., v3.3.5 is 335).

default_action_phase_1_logging_pass.description: Default action for phase 1. Controls logging and passing behavior. Default: log to error log and audit log, pass.

default_action_phase_2_logging_pass.description: Default action for phase 2. Controls logging and passing behavior. Default: log to error log and audit log, pass.
